name: יִדְבָּשׁ
summary: Idbash is named alongside Jezreel and Ishma in Judah’s genealogy. Their sister is Hazzelelponi.

evidence.note: The verse supplies the name and family setting.

note: The name preserves the three consonants of דְּבַשׁ after its initial yod. The genealogy gives no explanation of the name.
